title: Basic Socket Interface Extensions for IPv6

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 2553 defines protocol-independent nodename and service-name translation using getaddrinfo(), drawing from POSIX protocol-independent interface work.
RFC 2553 records design provenance including earlier Keith Sklower work and an early getaddrinfo prototype by Eric Allman.

notes: Key design-provenance source for protocol-independent name/service lookup.
